evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $189.948M, +20.7% YoY, with product revenue $111.158M and service revenue $78.790M.
Q2 overall gross margin was 60%; product gross margin 77% and service gross margin 35%.
H1 2026 operating income fell to $37.033M from $64.010M despite revenue growth to $363.881M.
H1 2026 operating cash flow was $41.842M and PPE purchases were $43.749M; SBC expense was $18.558M.
OCF-PPE was -$1.907M and OCF-PPE-SBC diagnostic was -$20.465M; neither is asserted as owner FCF.
Management reported a material weakness in controls over interim inventory movement; new controls were implemented in Q2 but the weakness was not yet remediated as of June 30, 2026.
Cash was $472.675M, convertible notes carrying value $454.260M, bank debt approximately $59.743M, and finance lease liability $347.660M at June 30, 2026.

The Somerville headquarters project is estimated to require $200M-$240M of capital through 2030; finance-lease economics include a $374.590M 2027 payment under the purchase-option accounting structure.
PAD Aviation investment closed July 1, 2026 to support a dedicated European organ-transplant logistics network; reviewed sources did not disclose transaction economics sufficient for underwriting.
At the $85.04 reference price, the unchanged scenario model values Bear/Base/Bull at approximately $17.18/$110.47/$362.76 per diluted share.
Holding the Base margin/capital structure assumptions fixed, the reference price requires approximately 7.8% annual revenue growth for years 2-10 and about $1.77B year-10 revenue.

counter_evidence: The service mix is rising and Q2 service gross margin improved to 35%, which supports logistics operating leverage rather than proving permanent margin compression.
Revenue guidance of $737M-$757M excludes PAD Aviation revenue and still implies about 22%-25% annual growth, so top-line demand remains stronger than the reverse-required growth rate.
Management concluded the Q2 financial statements fairly present the company's position under GAAP notwithstanding the internal-control weakness.
The current price is below the unchanged Base value, creating a more favorable expectation gap than on September 6.
